notes: REF-BM-03: title/description are editable after saving via the edit dialog, but the save flow (POST /api/bookmarks) creates the bookmark immediately from a URL with no pre-save preview/edit step, so 'before saving' is not realised. REF-BM-14: search query is split into words and matched via LIKE against title/description/url/note text; '#tag' is treated as a literal text term, not a tag selector (tag filtering exists only as separate clickable chips). REF-BM-15: search only ANDs all whitespace-separated words; no OR/NOT operators or parenthesised groups. REF-BM-16: no quote handling — quoted phrases are split on whitespace like any other words, so no exact-phrase match. REF-BM-20: no multi-select UI or bulk endpoint; actions are per-bookmark only. REF-BM-21: no bulk-to-filter action exists. REF-BM-22: listBookmarks always orders by created_at DESC with no sort-key parameter or UI control, so the user cannot choose a sort key. REF-BM-23: notes are written in a contenteditable rich-text editor (bold/list toolbar via execCommand) stored/rendered as sanitized HTML, not markdown — typed markdown syntax is not parsed. REF-BM-24: no page snapshot capability and no PDF handling. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity or feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (items-per-page fixed at 12, no font size or default-sort settings).
